options: With the LinearB MCP server, your AI sees how your teams ship next to your roadmap, incidents and pipeline, so it can answer questions, run automations and build reports no single tool could.

Ask Claude why a release is at risk, post a delivery brief to Slack every Monday, or build the board’s AI ROI slide, with LinearB data next to the rest of your tools.

With the LinearB MCP server, you can ask anything you’d ask LinearB from the AI tool your team works in, then turn the answer into a report, a scheduled Slack post or a page your leads open every morning.
